3005-tom-swift-and-his-airship.creator: Victor Appleton
3005-tom-swift-and-his-airship.description: A book by Victor Appleton. With a sudden hiss, as the powerful gas, under pressure, passed from the tank, through the pipes, and into the aluminum container, the hand on the gauge swept past figure after figure on the dial.

arxiv-2011-11016.title: Hyperbolic Distance versus QuasiHyperbolic Distance in Plane Domains
arxiv-2011-11016.creator: David A. Herron, Jeff Lindquist
arxiv-2011-11016.description: Abstract . We examine Euclidean plane domains with their hyperbolic or quasihyperbolic distance. We prove that the associated metric spaces are quasisymmetrically equivalent if and only if they are bi-Lipschitz equivalent. On the other hand, for Gromov hyperbolic domains, the two corresponding Gromov boundaries are always quasisymmetrically equivalent.

arxiv-2102-10955.title: Learning Purified Feature Representations from Task-irrelevant Labels
arxiv-2102-10955.creator: Yinghui Li 1,∗ , Chen Wang 2,∗ , Yangning Li 1,∗ , Hai-Tao Zheng 1,4,† , Ying Shen 3,†
arxiv-2102-10955.description: Abstract Learning an empirically effective model with generalization using limited data is a challenging task for deep neural networks. In this paper, we propose a novel learning framework called Purified Learning to exploit task-irrelevant features extracted from task-irrelevant labels when training models on small-scale datasets.

arxiv-2108-03180.title: Dynamic Semantic Occupancy Mapping using 3D Scene Flow and Closed-Form Bayesian Inference
arxiv-2108-03180.creator: AISHWARYA UNNIKRISHNAN 1, JOEY WILSON 1, LU GAN 1, ANDREW CAPODIECI 2, PARAMSOTHY JAYAKUMAR 3, KIRA BARTON 1, MAANI GHAFFARI 1
arxiv-2108-03180.description: Abstract This paper reports on a dynamic semantic mapping framework that incorporates 3D scene flow measurements into a closed-form Bayesian inference model. Existence of dynamic objects in the environment can cause artifacts and traces in current mapping algorithms, leading to an inconsistent map posterior.

arxiv-2202-10941.title: Recognizing Concepts and Recognizing Musical Themes. A Quantum Semantic Analysis
arxiv-2202-10941.creator: Maria Luisa Dalla Chiara, Roberto Giuntini, Eleonora Negri, Giuseppe Sergioli
arxiv-2202-10941.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Maria Luisa Dalla Chiara, Roberto Giuntini, Eleonora Negri, Giuseppe Sergioli. How are abstract concepts and musical themes recognized on the basis of some previous experience? It is interesting to compare the different behaviors of human and of artificial intelligences with respect to this problem.

arxiv-2311-15143.title: Reduced Augmentation Implicit Low-rank (RAIL) integrators for advection-diffusion and Fokker-Planck models
arxiv-2311-15143.creator: Joseph Nakao, Jing-Mei Qiu, Lukas Einkemmer
arxiv-2311-15143.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel computational approach termed the Reduced Augmentation Implicit Low-rank (RAIL) method by investigating two predominant research directions in low-rank solutions to time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs): dynamical low-rank (DLR), and step-and-truncation (SAT) tensor methods. The RAIL method is designed to enhance the efficiency of traditional full-rank implicit solvers, while maintaining accuracy and stability.

arxiv-2403-13767.title: Sensitivity of Bayesian 21 cm power spectrum estimation to foreground model errors 2023 Sensitivity of Bayesian 21 cm power spectrum estimation to foreground model errors – References
arxiv-2403-13767.creator: Jacob Burba, Philip Bull, Michael J. Wilensky, Fraser Kennedy, Hugh Garsden, Katrine A. Glasscock
arxiv-2403-13767.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jacob Burba, Philip Bull, Michael J. Wilensky, Fraser Kennedy, Hugh Garsden, Katrine A. Glasscock. Power spectrum estimators are an important tool in efforts to detect the 21 cm brightness temperature fluctuations from neutral hydrogen at early times. An initial detection will likely be statistical in nature, meaning that it will not be possible to make a coherent map of the brightness temperature fluctuations; instead, only their variance will be measured against a background of noise and residual systematic effects.

arxiv-2406-17511.title: Nanosecond Laser Annealing: impact on superconducting Silicon on Insulator epilayers
arxiv-2406-17511.creator: Y. Baron, J. L. Lábár, S. Lequien, B. Pécz, R. Daubriac, S. Kerdilès, P. Acosta ALba, C. Marcenat, D. Débarre, F. Lefloch, F. Chiodi
arxiv-2406-17511.description: Abstract We present superconducting monocrystalline Silicon On Insulator thin 33 nm epilayers. They are obtained by nanosecond laser annealing under ultra-high vacuum on 300 mm wafers heavily pre-implantated with boron ( 2.5 × 10 16 ​ a ​ t / c ​ m 2 2.5\times\,10^{16}\,at/cm^{2} , 3 keV).

arxiv-2412-13714.title: AnchorInv: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning of Physiological Signals via Feature Space-Guided Inversion
arxiv-2412-13714.creator: Chenqi Li, Boyan Gao, Gabriel Davis Jones, Timothy Denison, Tingting Zhu
arxiv-2412-13714.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chenqi Li, Boyan Gao, Gabriel Davis Jones, Timothy Denison, Tingting Zhu. Deep learning models have demonstrated exceptional performance in a variety of real-world applications. These successes are often attributed to strong base models that can generalize to novel tasks with limited supporting data while keeping prior knowledge intact. However, these impressive results are based on the availability of a large amount of high-quality data, which is often lacking in specialized biomedical applications.

arxiv-2508-20518.title: Bose-Einstein condensate of ultracold sodium-rubidium molecules with tunable dipolar interactions
arxiv-2508-20518.creator: Zhaopeng Shi, Zerong Huang, Fulin Deng, Wei-Jian Jin, Su Yi, Tao Shi, Dajun Wang
arxiv-2508-20518.description: Abstract Realizing Bose-Einstein condensation of polar molecules is a long-standing challenge in ultracold physics and quantum science due to near-universal two-body collisional losses. Here, we report the production of a Bose-Einstein condensate of ground-state sodium-rubidium molecules via high efficiency evaporative cooling, with losses suppressed using the dual microwave shielding technique.

arxiv-2509-23914.title: Experimental study of diffusiophoresis in a cellular flow
arxiv-2509-23914.creator: Florence Raynal 1, Menghua Zhao 1 2, Romain Volk 2
arxiv-2509-23914.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Florence Raynal 1, Menghua Zhao 1 2, Romain Volk 2. In this article, we study experimentally the dispersion of colloids in a two-dimensional, time independent, Rayleigh-Bénard flow in the presence of salt gradients. Due to the additional scalar, the colloids do not follow exactly the Eulerian flow-field, but have a (small) extra-velocity 𝐯 dp = D dp ∇ log C s \mathbf{v}_{\mathrm{dp}}=D_{\mathrm{dp}}\nabla\log C_{s} , where D dp D_{\mathrm{dp}} is the phoretic constant and C s C_{s} the salt concentration.

pmc-10576458.title: The Role of Caspase-11 and Pyroptosis in the Regulation of Inflammation in Peri-Implantitis
pmc-10576458.creator: Pengcheng Jiao, Zuntai Li, Birong Li, Xingyuan Jiao
pmc-10576458.description: Peri-implantitis is an important cause of oral implant failure. In the past, TLR4 and TLR2 in the Toll-like family were generally considered as the key immune recognition receptors regulating peri-implantitis. However, under the guidance of this theory, there are still some unexplainable peri-implantitis symptoms.

pmc-10639155.title: Myopia and sleep in children—a systematic review
pmc-10639155.creator: Xiao Nicole Liu, Thomas John Naduvilath, Padmaja R Sankaridurg
pmc-10639155.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Worldwide, approximately one in three people are myopic or short-sighted. Myopia in children is of particular concern as younger onset age implies a higher risk of progression, and consequently greater risk of developing vision-threatening complications. The importance of sleep in children’s health has long been acknowledged, but evidence for its role in childhood myopia is fairly new and mixed results were presented across studies.

pmc-10706099.title: Surviving the Storm: The Impact of COVID-19 on Cervical Cancer Screening in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
pmc-10706099.creator: Mandana Vahabi, Anam Shahil-Feroz, Aisha Lofters, Josephine Pui-Hing Wong, Vijayshree Prakash, Sharmila Pimple, Kavita Anand, Gauravi Mishra, Li Yang, Rosa Legood, Fei Ma
pmc-10706099.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). According to the Center for Disease Control and Prevention’s National Breast and Cervical Cancer Early Detection Program, the cervical cancer screening rate dropped by 84% soon after the declaration of the COVID-19 pandemic. The challenges facing cervical cancer screening were largely attributed to the required in-person nature of the screening process and the measures implemented to control the spread of the virus.

pmc-11325747.title: Factors associated with uptake of isoniazid preventive therapy among children living with HIV in Mwanza region, Tanzania: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11325747.creator: Ally Tuwa, David Okia, Ritah Nantale, Hyasinta Jaka, Jimmy Patrick Alunyo, David Mukunya, Joseph KB Matovu, Dan Kibuule
pmc-11325747.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) is a leading cause of death among children living with HIV (CLHIV). Isoniazid preventive therapy (IPT) reduces the incidence of TB by 70% and mortality by 50% among CLHIV. However, in most developing countries including Tanzania, the uptake of IPT is suboptimal, below the 90% WHO-global uptake target.

pmc-11331580.title: Detection of low-concentration heavy metal exploiting Tamm resonance in a porous TiO2 photonic crystal
pmc-11331580.creator: Asmaa M. Elsayed, Ashour M. Ahmed, Arafa H. Aly, M. F. Eissa, M. T. Tammam
pmc-11331580.description: The detection of heavy metal ions, particularly Hg2+, has gained significant attention due to their severe adverse effects on human health and ecosystems. Conventional methods for monitoring these metals in freshwater often suffer from limitations in sensitivity, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.

pmc-11489991.title: Challenges associated with the implementation of institutional quarantine and isolation strategies during major multicountry viral outbreaks in Africa (2000–2023): a scoping review
pmc-11489991.creator: Jimoh Amzat, Ebunoluwa Oduwole, Saheed Akinmayowa Lawal, Olusola Aluko-Arowolo, Rotimi Afolabi, Isaac Akinkunmi Adedeji, Ige Angela Temisan, Ayoyinka Oludiran, Kafayat Aminu, Afeez Abolarinwa Salami, Kehinde Kazeem Kanmodi
pmc-11489991.description: BackgroundQuarantine and isolation (Q&I) are interrelated but not mutually exclusive public health practices for disease control, which may face public resistance in the context of health emergencies due to associated challenges. Hence, it is often tough for most countries to implement Q&I even in the context of health emergencies.

pmc-11505862.title: AML-DECODER: Advanced Machine Learning for HD-sEMG Signal Classification—Decoding Lateral Epicondylitis in Forearm Muscles
pmc-11505862.creator: Mehdi Shirzadi, Mónica Rojas Martínez, Joan Francesc Alonso, Leidy Yanet Serna, Joaquim Chaler, Miguel Angel Mañanas, Hamid Reza Marateb
pmc-11505862.description: Background: Innovative algorithms for wearable devices and garments are critical for diagnosing and monitoring disease (such as lateral epicondylitis (LE)) progression. LE affects individuals across various professions and causes daily problems. Methods: We analyzed signals from the forearm muscles of 14 healthy controls and 14 LE patients using high-density surface electromyography.

pmc-11513308.title: Investigating factors influencing overweight and obesity among adult households in Ethiopia: a multilevel ordered analysis of 2016 EDHS data
pmc-11513308.creator: Alemayehu Deressa, Dawit Firdisa, Abdi Birhanu, Adera Debella, Mulugeta Gamachu, Addis Eyeberu, Deribe Bekele Dechasa, Usmael Jibro, Bikila Balis, Moti Tolera, Lemma Demissie Regassa, Ibsa Mussa
pmc-11513308.description: BackgroundIn both high- and low-income countries, including Ethiopia, overweight and obesity have emerged as public health issues of the 21st century. Hence, obtaining conclusive evidence concerning the factors that influence adults’ body mass index is important. Therefore, using representative data, our study sought to provide solid evidence on factors influencing overweight and obesity among adults in Ethiopia.

pmc-11525745.title: Evaluation of Conductive Porous Biobased Composites with Tunable Mechanical Properties for Potential Biological Applications
pmc-11525745.creator: Laria Rodríguez-Quesada, Karla Ramírez-Sánchez, Cécile Formosa-Dague, Etienne Dague, Giovanni Sáenz-Arce, Carlos A García-González, Fabián Vásquez-Sancho, Esteban Avendaño-Soto, Ricardo Starbird-Pérez
pmc-11525745.description: In this work, starch-based porous cryogels with controlled mechanical and electrical properties were prepared for tissue engineering applications. The starch cryogels were formulated using κ-carrageenan, poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA), and styrylpyridinium-substituted PVA (SbQ) into the composite. A conductive cryogel was polymerized by chemical oxidation of 3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene (EDOT) using iron(III) p-toluenesulfonate as a strategy to control the electrical properties.

pmc-11606189.title: Impact of Intraoperative Nanocarbon Staining and parathyroid autotransplantation on parathyroid injury and recovery in adult thyroidectomy: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11606189.creator: Chen Chen, Xiaole Wang, Gang Liu, Yi Huang
pmc-11606189.description: BackgroundThyroid surgeries are intricate operations that carry the risk of damaging the parathyroid glands, which can result in hypocalcemia and potential long-term hypoparathyroidism. Innovative surgical techniques including Intraoperative Nanocarbon Staining (INS), aim to enhance the preservation of parathyroid glands. This study assesses the effectiveness of INS combined with parathyroid autotransplantation in reducing postoperative complications and preserving parathyroid function.

pmc-12737156.title: Strategic Combinations of Antibody–Drug Conjugates from 2023 to 2025: From Dual Therapies to Innovative ADC-Based Regimens
pmc-12737156.creator: Heewon Jang, Ji-Eun Chang, Anke Wilhelm
pmc-12737156.description: Antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) are a potent class of targeted cancer therapies that combine the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of chemotherapeutic agents. By targeting tumor cells with minimal impact on healthy tissues, ADCs achieve a favorable balance between efficacy and systemic toxicity.

pmc-13064769.title: Introducing a special collection of CME articles about long-acting injectable antipsychotics
pmc-13064769.creator: Leslie Citrome
pmc-13064769.description: Long-acting injectable (LAI) antipsychotics are not routinely offered and, thus, are underutilized despite their many advantages over oral formulations. In this special collection of articles, the reader will find overviews of the art and science of prescribing this important treatment option. Guidance is offered regarding incorporating LAIs in treatment planning, including inpatient, outpatient, and jail settings.

pmc-13246288.title: Cardiovascular Risk of Alcohol Consumption due to Renal Impairment: A 10-Year Prospective Study in a Community-Dwelling Japanese Population
pmc-13246288.creator: Aya Hirata, Sei Harada, Miho Iida, Minako Matsumoto, Naoko Miyagawa, Ryota Toki, Shun Edagawa, Takuma Shibuki, Kazuyo Kuwabara, Shun Kohsaka, Yoshikane Izawa, Mitsuaki Sawano, Tsubasa Takizawa, Satoshi Shoji, Masahiro Katsumata, Daisuke Sugiyama, Tomonori Okamura, Toru Takebayashi
pmc-13246288.description: Aims: The association between alcohol consumption and the risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) varies according to the presence of underlying cardiovascular risk factors. Incorporating such risk factors may be important to effectively reduce harmful alcohol use through health guidance. However, whether the risk of alcohol consumption is affected due to renal impairment remains unclear.

pmc-13279031.title: Evaluation of large language model responses to patient questions on oral anticoagulant therapy: a comparative expert assessment
pmc-13279031.creator: Mohammed Amer Khan, Vaibhav Chaudhary, Mohammed Maazuddin, Ihtisham Sultan, Saamiya Mehnaaz, Biplab Pal
pmc-13279031.description: BackgroundLarge language model (LLM)–based chatbots are increasingly used by patients for health information; however, their reliability in high-risk cardiovascular therapies such as oral anticoagulation remains uncertain. This study evaluated the perceived accuracy, clarity, and completeness of LLM-generated responses to common patient queries compared with standard-derived expert responses (SDERs).MethodsA cross-sectional comparative study evaluated responses generated by ChatGPT-4.5, Gemini Pro 2.

pmc-13465454.title: Anticipatory Grief Among Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients in Home Palliative Care: A Constructivist Grounded Theory
pmc-13465454.creator: Camila Carreira, Ana Ramos, Maria João Mateus, Paula Pinto, Amira Mohammed Ali, Feten Fekih-Romdhane, Selma Yıldırım, Murat Yıldırım, Carlos Laranjeira
pmc-13465454.description: Background/Objectives: Anticipatory grief is a significant phenomenon in the experience of family caregivers of individuals receiving palliative care (PC) at home, representing a complex emotional response to impending loss. Nevertheless, there is scarce research supporting an in-depth, context-sensitive understanding of caregivers’ lived experiences in home settings.
